notes.title: Helixteus 3 is on Kickstarter!
notes.notes:
Hey all, I started a Kickstarter campaign for Helixteus 3!

Just to be clear, I don't need any funds to continue developing and finishing this game. Rather, I decided to try this to give the long-time players and supporters an opportunity to get exclusive stuff, while at the same time helping me to better polish the game.

Here's the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/apple0726/helixteus-3]Kickstarter page[/url]. The campaign will last 30 days. You'll see a detailed explanation of the current state of the game, as well as all the rewards you can get depending on how much you pledge.

Thanks for your support!
